newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates backs Sudan's unity.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates backs Sudan's unity.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates on Tuesday joined other Arab states in backing Sudan's unity and sovereignty, the official WAM news agency reported.
It said UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan stressed the Gulf Arab state's backing for Sudan's security and unity and the sovereignty of its territory.

He made the remarks after a meeting with visiting Sudanese Cabinet Affairs Minister Salah-Eddin Mohammad Ahmed Karrar who arrived earlier in the day to brief UAE leaders on the military conflict in his country.
Sudan's military government has called for mobilisation against what it says are attacks by troops of neighbours Eritrea and Ethiopia. Both states deny these charges.
Sudanese Vice-President al-Zubeir Mohammad Saleh arrived in Qatar hours earlier as part of a tour of Arab states to brief leaders on developments in Sudan.
He said he received the backing of the Doha government.
